avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce tamsulosin levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or consult healthcare provider before combining

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbe
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-adrenergic agonist may antagonize tamsulosin's therapeutic effect and increase blood pressure
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; may counteract symptomatic relief of BPH

caution_supplements.name: Saw Palmetto
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive alpha-blocking effects and increase hypotensive risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; inform provider of concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 inhibition may increase tamsulosin levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects (dizziness, syncope)

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases tamsulosin bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products from diet; risk of hypotension and syncope

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase tamsulosin absorption and delay peak plasma concentration
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain routine for consistent efficacy

monitoring_notes: Monitor for orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, and syncope especially with CYP3A4 inhibitors. Counsel on consistent dosing timing relative to meals and avoidance of grapefruit products.
